about: Rows of the Federal Reserve Board's two enforcement-action files, read 2026-10-27 (federalreserve.gov/supervisionreg/ea-old.json, 2,514 actions 1989-09-25 to 2018-12-26; /supervisionreg/files/ea-cms-recent.json, 385 since 2019-01-18), as the Board gives them: every row any FED_BANKS pattern or a broad name search for the mapped banks, their predecessors and namesakes finds, and the actions against people who worked at JPMorgan, Wells Fargo or Goldman Sachs. Batch 74 added, from the same two files read 2026-10-30, every row naming a foreign bank with a page here, its US units and the namesakes the map must refuse (Bankers Trust of Des Moines, Community Bankers Trust, Newark's City National Bancshares, the Capital and Tennessee Commerce Bancorps, the Irwin, Highlands and Bowling Green Union Banks), Credit Suisse's, and Banco Popular's. Batch 78 added row 1224, Compass Bank's penalty of 2009-09-21, from ea-old.json read 2026-10-30 by the audit (its finding 3).
